title: hypericum monanthemum subsp. filicaule
intro: Hypericum monanthemum subsp. filicaule, commonly known as Saint John's Wort, is a flowering plant that belongs to the St. John's Wort genus. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and depression, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of menopause, due to its therapeutic actions of sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Saint John's Wort include hyperforin, hypericin, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. These bioactive compounds have been shown to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, making Saint John's Wort a popular herbal remedy for various health conditions.
